scenes: What happens to school in a heatwave?
A hot classroom is hard to learn in, | and when it becomes unsafe, schools close.
In 2024, heatwaves disrupted the schooling of one hundred and seventy-one million students. | South Asia was the most affected region.
In the Philippines, five thousand two hundred and eighty-eight schools switched to remote learning in one week of April 2024.
Cool roofs, shade and water, so school can stay open.
